## Summary
Generate structured rationales with Toulmin argumentation chains and compute QA scores for each item, providing faculty with transparent reasoning and automated quality metrics.

## User story
As a faculty reviewer, I want each generated item to have a structured rationale explaining why the key is correct and why each distractor is wrong, so that I can quickly validate clinical accuracy and provide students with high-quality explanations.

## Why this matters
Rationales are what students see after answering. A wrong or unclear rationale teaches the wrong thing. The Toulmin chain provides structured argumentation that faculty can audit. QA scores provide automated quality metrics that prioritize faculty review time on the worst items first.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Generates rationale for the key (why correct) and each distractor (why incorrect)
- [ ] Toulmin chain structure: Claim, Data, Warrant, Backing, Qualifier, Rebuttal
- [ ] QA score computed across dimensions: clinical accuracy, stem quality, distractor plausibility, Bloom alignment, NBME format
- [ ] Overall QA score: 0-100 numeric scale
- [ ] Model: HAIKU_MODEL for rationale + QA scoring (cost-efficient)
- [ ] Rationale prompt loaded from packages/ai/prompts/rationale.md via loadPrompt
- [ ] All Claude responses parsed with safeJsonParse (Rule 2)
- [ ] Batch items processed with Promise.allSettled (Rule 3)
- [ ] Context sanitized via sanitizeForContext (Rule 5)
- [ ] Output shape: `{ rationale: { key: ToulminChain, distractors: ToulminChain[] }, qaScore: QAScore }`
- [ ] Items with QA score < 60 are flagged for priority faculty review

## Code patterns to follow
```typescript
// apps/inngest/functions/p3-steps/rationale-qa.ts
import { safeJsonParse } from '@journey/ai/safe-parse';
import { HAIKU_MODEL } from '@journey/ai/constants';
import { sanitizeForContext, buildContextBlock } from '@journey/ai/sanitize';
import { loadPrompt } from '@journey/ai/prompts';

interface ToulminChain {
  claim: string;
  data: string;
  warrant: string;
  backing: string;
  qualifier: string;
  rebuttal: string;
}

interface QAScore {
  overall: number; // 0-100
  dimensions: {
    clinicalAccuracy: number;
    stemQuality: number;
    distractorPlausibility: number;
    bloomAlignment: number;
    nbmeFormat: number;
  };
  flaggedForReview: boolean; // true if overall < 60
}

export async function rationaleAndQA(
  items: GeneratedItem[],
  contextWindow: string
): Promise<ItemWithRationaleQA[]> {
  const rationalePrompt = await loadPrompt('rationale');

  const results = await Promise.allSettled(
    items.map(item => generateRationaleAndScore(item, rationalePrompt, contextWindow))
  );

  return results
    .filter((r): r is PromiseFulfilledResult<ItemWithRationaleQA> => r.status === 'fulfilled')
    .map(r => r.value);
}
```

  const result = await generateRationaleAndScore(mockItem, mockPrompt, mockContext);
  expect(result.qaScore.overall).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(0);
  expect(result.qaScore.overall).toBeLessThanOrEqual(100);
});
